label: Luck
description: Marked to do something you normally couldn't, or to change a roll to a 10+. All of it is regained when a school year is completed.

full.text: The witch or wizard has 4 Experience: they may take an Advancement now, and this Experience is cleared.

label: Advancements
description: Advancements the witch or wizard may take. One is earned at 4 Experience and one each time a school year is completed.
